resources.string: Your own file icons, ahead of the icon theme: a file name, an extension or a glob mapped to an icon id of the active theme, for example {\"*.foo\": \"python\", \"Jenkinsfile\": \"docker\"}. Edit in settings.json.

Your own folder icons: a folder name mapped to a folder icon id of the active theme, for example {\"api\": \"folder-api\"}. The open folder uses the id with -open added when the theme has it. Edit in settings.json.
File and folder icons from an installed icon theme, in the explorer, quick open, search and source control.
This icon theme draws its icons from a font, which easyIDE cannot show. File rows keep the built-in icons; pick a theme with SVG or PNG icons.
No icon themes installed. Extensions can contribute one.
Workbench colours laid over the theme, by VS Code colour id; a \"[Theme name]\" block applies to one theme.
Syntax colours and font styles (textMateRules, roles) laid over the theme.
Colours for language server tokens by selector, and whether semantic colouring is on.
